topics.label: Course introduction and lecture learning outcomes
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic provides the introductory welcome, course framing, and learning outcomes for the lecture series.

topics.label: Cellular differentiation, genetic alterations, and tissue architecture in cancer
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics explain the biological foundations of cancer as a failure of genetic stability, cellular differentiation programs, and three-dimensional tissue architecture, including approaches to modeling them.

topics.label: Mechanisms and histology of tumor invasion and metastasis
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine the pathological characteristics, anatomical routes, and histological progression of tumor invasion and metastatic dissemination from benign precursor lesions.

topics.label: Tumor nomenclature, clinical risks, and pathophysiological causes of mortality
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics address the standard classification and naming conventions for neoplasms alongside the pathophysiological mechanisms by which benign and malignant tumors cause clinical illness and death.

topics.label: Cancer incidence and comparative oncology across taxa
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics examine epidemiological patterns of tumor incidence in humans and the comparative occurrence of cancer across diverse animal species and multicellular organisms.

topics.label: Clinical symptoms and cancer screening modalities
topics.groupedBecause: These subtopics discuss early clinical signs of malignancy and evaluate the implementation, efficacy, and limitations of screening programs for various cancer types.

topics.label: Lecture conclusion and housekeeping
topics.groupedBecause: This subtopic delivers the closing framing, concluding the lecture with reminders about learning outcomes and upcoming practical sessions.
